prediction.prediction: Each callback latches its low/high row mapping from signed entry y and recomputes that expression for each row. A8F0's source y selects the mapping for both source and destination; its destination x/y arguments are loaded as DWORDs, and the full destination-y value participates in the low-entry row comparison.
prediction.falsifier: A native read/write address disagrees with the entry-selected expression, destination y=65536 behaves as low-WORD zero, or static instructions show WORD loads/cached row pointers/narrower destination counters.
prediction.scope: Finite original A710/A8F0 cases with small positive heights, including A8F0 destination-y 65536, x=65536 masked-address, and 32767-to-32768 counter discriminators. Original BD80 gate only; no game, OS/window, DirectDraw, resource data, overlap, negative dimensions, or canonical edits.

native_execution.bd80: original disabled gate pointer/gate path; callback endpoint not executed
native_execution.memory_trace: all A710 external source reads, A8F0 texture-range reads, and all .data writes recorded by address/size/PC

row_models.public_normal_helper: row=y for y<256; row=0x800+(y&0xff) for 256<=y<512; this is the standalone helper's per-row domain
row_models.public_high_helper: row=0x1000+(y&0x1ff) for 512<=y<=1023; helper rejects other y; this is the standalone helper's per-row domain
row_models.observed_entry_band_contract: Callback chooses low or high code once from the initial signed y WORD (A710 destination RECT y; A8F0 source RECT y). The chosen code then recomputes source/destination row expressions each iteration using the current y values. A8F0 applies the source-entry band branch to both source and destination row addressing.
row_models.cached_pointer_model: Rejected by finite boundary witnesses: both callbacks recompute row expressions; +0x100 continuation is not a general contract.
row_models.helper_mismatch: Standalone per-logical-row helpers disagree when a rectangle crosses a callback's entry-band branch or the high helper's y<=1023 limit. The native fixtures do not broaden or modify either public helper.
row_models.higher_domain: No helper contract is broadened; y=1024 is reported only as the second row of the y=1023 native fixture.

static_height_observation.A710: At RVA 0xA71F, CMP CX,0x200 followed by signed JL at 0xA725 selects the entry band. Height is MOVSX at 0xA72E (high) or 0xA801 (low), width at 0xA740/0xA834; y+height is compared with signed JGE/JL loop control. Zero height still reaches BD80 in prior finite fixtures. No general invalid-input behavior claimed.
static_height_observation.A8F0: At RVA 0xA8FE, CMP CX,0x200 followed by signed JL at 0xA904 selects the entry band from source y. Height is MOVSX at 0xA90D (high) or 0xAA6E (low), width at 0xA925/0xAAB4. Destination x/y are read as DWORD stack values at [esp+0x28]/[esp+0x2c]; the low-entry y=65536 fixture distinguishes the full value from low-WORD truncation. Destination y is incremented with 32-bit INC EBX at 0xABD3; the 32767-to-32768 fixture observes the continuation. No general invalid-input behavior claimed.

static_destination_counter_observation.cdecl_stack_map: At entry, return/[esp+0], RECT/[esp+4], destination_x/[esp+8], destination_y/[esp+0xc]. SUB ESP,0x10 and four 32-bit register pushes move ESP down 0x20, so the original destination_y argument is current [esp+0x2c].
static_destination_counter_observation.bounded_discriminator: source RECT y=0, destination y=32767, width=1, height=2; native rows write with low-entry rows 0x8ff then 0x800, not the i16-narrowed second-row result.

frame_span.label: cdecl frame, full DWORD destination-y argument slot, entry band and row-loop setup

static_destination_argument_width_observ.cdecl_stack_map: At entry, destination_x is DWORD [esp+0x8] and destination_y is DWORD [esp+0xc]. SUB ESP,0x10 and four 32-bit pushes move them to current [esp+0x28] and [esp+0x2c]. Source RECT x/y remain signed WORD fields.

native_discriminators.destination_y_65536: With source RECT y=0 and destination y=65536, width=1, height=1, native output is 0x9ee708/09 from low-entry row 0x800; WORD truncation to zero would write 0x96e708/09.
native_discriminators.destination_x_65536: With source RECT x/y=5/0 and destination x=65536,y=0,width=1,height=1, native output aliases x=0 at 0x96e6e0/e1 because the byte-address expression masks higher x bits. This only establishes the single-word address expression, not arbitrary-width clipping or 32-bit wraparound.

static_row_counter_observation.width: All listed INC instructions are 32-bit register operations; source RECT y is sign-extended on entry. The DWORD A8F0 destination argument is loaded from [esp+0x2c].
static_row_counter_observation.implication: The row-address helper takes renderer_i32 current_y; only the callback entry-y selector takes renderer_i16.

limitations: Finite synthetic rectangles only; negative coordinates, negative dimensions, clipping, huge heights, and all invalid-input semantics are unproved.
The high-y helper remains domain-limited to y=512..1023; the y=1024 row is only observed as the next iteration of a rectangle beginning at 1023.
No allocation ownership or texture backing extent is inferred from these addresses.
No source/destination overlap case was added; existing native_vram_move.json covers finite overlap behavior separately.
No DirectDraw, GPU, gameplay, FUNCTION_MATCH, source identity, or whole-module equality is claimed.
